notes.title: Pre-release hype and info
notes.notes:
Tomorrow is the big day - picoCAD launches on Steam! 

I couldn't have wished for a better ramp up to the launch, picoCAD is featured on the Popular Upcoming list and wishlists are pouring in! Yesterday we were well on our way to 8k. Amazing! Thank you so much for your interest in this little tool!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057634/b24aa4dea0300c2c12d6c9f7f345b30b22d383df.gif

I made picoCAD to be able to make simple models for my own projects as it was impossible to find something that just made 3D modelling simple and easy. However, the program turned out more interesting to work with and became its own thing. 

To see some really cool builds from the community, just head over to picoCAD.net to check out what's possible. Once picoCAD is out, this site will be packed with tutorials and great resources to get going.

Since picoCAD is built with pico8, it is rich with restrictions. My intention is that these will fuel creativity and make it even more fun to make small models. Should you need to break out of picoCAD's confinement - export to OBJ and take your project into any other 3D modeler!

I really hope that you will find the tight design space available in picoCAD a joy to work with.

See you tomorrow!
Johan

notes.title: Release date and price reveal!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 
Happy to announce that we finally have a release date for picoCAD and that it is soon!

🗓️ Release date: November 28, 2024
🪙 Price: $5.99
📉 Launch discount: 15%

In the meantime, check out the brand new picoCAD website. Currently packed with examples of what you will be able to make, but post launch it will also hold all sorts of good stuff for picoCAD, including tutorials, external tools, and more. 

https://www.picocad.net/


Last but not least, we've passed 5000 wishlists! I'd love if you could spend a minute and tell everyone you know about picoCAD and ask them to wishlist. Even if there is no intention to buy it, every wishlist increases the chance to get boosted by the Steam algorithm. Maybe we can even get to 6000? Thanks!
 :D 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057634/ab0cb60dd0d5321b46699e1dc5a730e70a71b87a.gif

Stay tuned!
Johan
